configuration.fit: TMLE(learned_rule=LearnedRule(), interventions=[Static(1), Static(0)], n_folds=10, cv_evaluation=True, targeting_scheme='pooled', g_bounds='auto', random_state=<fold seed>) at n = 2000; every other setting the constructor's default (simultaneous=True, whose band the fit skips); repeats=1
configuration.stacked_fit: the same with cv_evaluation=False, on the same draw and fold seed
configuration.outcome_learner: Pipeline(PolynomialFeatures(2, interaction_only=True, include_bias=False), LogisticRegression(C=1e6, max_iter=5000, tol=1e-10)) on (A, W1, W2)

laws.non_exceptional: RM30 law with blip 0.1 + W1; calibration bands
laws.misspecified_limit: RM30 law with blip 0.8 W1 + W1^2 - 0.3; bias leg and coverage floor 0.92 only (Corollary 3's route, by the paper's analogy); the omitted projection term is negligible here (predicted SE ratio at most 1.0005), so the cells measure coverage under a misspecified treated arm, not conservativeness

configuration.variance: fold-evaluated: V^-2 sum_v n_v^-2 sum_{i in v} D_i^2 of each curve, D_L - D_K for a contrast; stacked: the centred rule {n (n - 1)}^-1 sum_i (phi_i - phibar)^2 of the stored curve, the difference of the two curves for a contrast
configuration.truth: per replication: refit each fold's outcome learner on the fit's training rows with the package's fit_on_rows, require the fit's rule on every validation row (rule L4), integrate each fold rule's value by the trapezoid rule on 4001 points of W1 for each W2 with the known Qbar0, and weight fold v by the report's fold weight (1/V, or n_v/n stacked), checked against the record's fold_weights; a known regime's truth is E Qbar0(a, W) by the same rule; a contrast's is the difference
configuration.oracle_se: sqrt(sum_v omega_v^2 Var D_v / n_v) of each curve at the fold rules; descriptive
configuration.conservative_coverage: misspecified_limit: bias leg and coverage interval lower bound >= 0.92; control: SE x 0.60, coverage interval upper bound < 0.92
configuration.contrast_covariance: each contrast with se = |se_L - se_K| (correlation one); coverage interval upper bound < 0.80
configuration.independent_se_diagnostic: each contrast with se = sqrt(se_L^2 + se_K^2) (independence); diagnostic, no verdict
configuration.targeting_necessity: RM30's drop_w1_learner, fold-evaluated, contrast against Static(0): targeted against the untargeted difference of the initial plug-ins
